item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"write\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"work.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Evaluate state transition requests against a policy.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n\\ndef evaluate(request, policy):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Return the result of applying *request* under *policy*.\\n\\n    Neither input is modified.  An ``attempts`` field marks a retry and is\\n    valid only when it is a non-boolean integer within the policy's retry\\n    range.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    edge_key = f\\\"{request.get('from')}>{request.get('to')}\\\"\\n    edge = policy.get(\\\"edges\\\", {}).get(edge_key)\\n\\n    if edge is None:\\n        return {\\\"ok\\\": False, \\\"value\\\": None, \\\"reason\\\": \\\"blocked\\\"}\\n\\n    required_role = edge.get(\\\"role\\\")\\n    if required_role is not None and request.get(\\\"role\\\") != required_role:\\n        return {\\\"ok\\\": False, \\\"value\\\": None, \\\"reason\\\": \\\"permission\\\"}\\n\\n    if \\\"attempts\\\" in request:\\n        attempts = request[\\\"attempts\\\"]\\n        retry_limit = policy.get(\\\"retry_limit\\\")\\n        if (\\n            isinstance(attempts, bool)\\n            or not isinstance(attempts, int)\\n            or not isinstance(retry_limit, int)\\n            or isinstance(retry_limit, bool)\\n            or attempts < 0\\n            or attempts >= retry_limit\\n        ):\\n            return {\\\"ok\\\": False, \\\"value\\\": None, \\\"reason\\\": \\\"retry_limit\\\"}\\n\\n    return {\\\"ok\\\": True, \\\"value\\\": request.get(\\\"to\\\"), \\\"reason\\\": \\\"ok\\\"}\\n\"}},{\"action\":\"write\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"report.json\",\"content\":\"[\\n  {\\n    \\\"ok\\\": true,\\n    \\\"value\\\": \\\"ready\\\",\\n    \\\"reason\\\": \\\"ok\\\"\\n  },\\n  {\\n    \\\"ok\\\": true,\\n    \\\"value\\\": \\\"running\\\",\\n    \\\"reason\\\": \\\"ok\\\"\\n  }\\n]\\n\"}}]}"}
